title: Solar-farm onset (day-only repeats)
asserts: an unmapped solar farm seen only by day, one detection per poll (one pixel on day 1, one at 10:50 and one at 12:10 on day 2, all within one site), is quarantined as suspected_static_source on the third detection and no alert is sent after the quarantine; the second detection passes alert_gating_v1 (minDetections 2) before the quarantine (3) can exist, so the zone gets one new_fire plus its digest at 10:50 and then invalidated at 12:10 — the founder ruling of 2026-10-30 (S10 option 3) accepts that one early alert rather than delaying real day-only fires
